summary: Tested UI/UX improvements for Kona splash screen: (1) KONA typewriter animation, (2) No underline on KONA text, (3) KonaLoader/PageLoader integration. All tests PASSED on both desktop and mobile.
passed_tests: Pre-splash screen displays clickable Kona logo with pulsing ring animation
Pre-splash shows 'Sound on' hint at bottom
KONA text appears with typewriter effect (4 letters: K, O, N, A fade in sequentially)
typewriterFade keyframe animation applies to each letter with staggered delay (0.18s per letter)
KONA text has NO underline - textDecoration: 'none' verified on all 4 letters
KONA text uses gradient background (purple gradient from #8B5CF6 to #E879F9)
Homepage loads correctly after splash animation completes (~5 seconds)
HomePage.jsx uses PageLoader component for loading state
BusinessDashboard.jsx uses PageLoader component for loading state
AdminDashboard.jsx uses KonaLoader and PageLoader components
CreatorPortal.jsx uses PageLoader and KonaLoader components
SeriesDetailPage.jsx uses PageLoader component for loading state
critical_code_review_comments: Typewriter effect implemented correctly using CSS keyframes 'typewriterFade' with 0.15s duration and staggered delays
Each letter has opacity: 0 initially and uses 'forwards' to maintain final state
No text-decoration property set, so no underline appears
KonaLoader uses svg with animate-spin and 1.5s duration for consistent branding
PageLoader uses KonaLoader internally with size=60 and displays a loading message
All 5 specified pages (HomePage, BusinessDashboard, AdminDashboard, CreatorPortal, SeriesDetailPage) correctly import and use the Kona-branded loader components
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash screen UI/UX improvements verified. The typewriter effect for 'KONA' text works on both desktop and mobile. No underline present. All key pages use KonaLoader/PageLoader for consistent branding. The splash animation phases: Phase 1 (particles), Phase 2 (logo zoom+sound), Phase 3 (glow), Phase 4 (KONA typewriter), Phase 5 (tagline - removed), Phase 6 (hold), Phase 7 (fade out).

splash_screen_typewriter.details: Each letter of 'KONA' fades in sequentially with 0.18s delay between letters
splash_screen_typewriter.animation: typewriterFade keyframe with opacity 0->1 and translateY 10px->0

no_underline.details: All 4 letters have textDecoration: 'none' on both desktop and mobile
